Part B’s components

Frames, icons, the download card and its states, feature blocks, buttons in every state, and a step with a screenshot.

Screenshot frames

One per kind of screen. The picture keeps its own shape; the frame is symmetric and never mirrors.

Icons

24-unit grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps. The first row mirrors on an Arabic page; the rest never do.

A feature block

  • It makes subtitles

    Maktaba listens to each film on the computer at home and writes its subtitles. Arabic and English both work.

    How subtitles are made

  1. Your NAS

    Answer a few questions about your NAS, and the page writes the project file for you.

Maktabaمكتبة

Maktaba keeps a household’s films and series on its own computer, and plays them on every screen at home, in Arabic and English. Free and open source, under the MIT licence.
